jyutping: m4 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 laa3
meaning: I won’t bother you so much anymore
usage: A polite Cantonese phrase meaning 'I won’t bother you so much anymore'
A softer and more humble version of 唔阻你喇
咁多 means 'so much', implying you may have taken up a lot of someone’s time
Often used when ending a conversation or after asking many questions
Common in polite spoken Cantonese, especially in Hong Kong

examples.jyutping: m4 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 laa3
examples.meaning: I won’t bother you so much anymore.

examples.sentence: 唔好意思，唔阻你咁多喇。
examples.jyutping: m4 hou2 ji3 si3, m4 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 laa3
examples.meaning: Sorry, I won’t bother you so much anymore.

examples.sentence: 問咗你咁多問題，唔阻你咁多喇。
examples.jyutping: man6 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 man6 tai4, m4 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 laa3
examples.meaning: I asked you so many questions — I won’t bother you so much anymore.

examples.sentence: 你忙緊，我唔阻你咁多喇，遲啲再講。
examples.jyutping: nei5 mong4 gan2, ngo5 m4 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 laa3, ci4 di1 zoi3 gong2
examples.meaning: You’re busy — I won’t bother you so much. We’ll talk later.

examples.sentence: 多謝你幫我，我唔阻你咁多喇，再見。
examples.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5, ngo5 m4 zo2 nei5 gam3 do1 laa3, zoi3 gin3
examples.meaning: Thanks for helping me — I won’t bother you so much anymore. Goodbye.
